title: A production alert starts an agent job that opens a pull request, and nothing is applied or merged (Forgejo only; the model command is the bench's own)

steps.label: the repository holds the secrets the agent's workflow reads
main sets agent.alert, with the bench's own model command
the relay takes one signed alert and records its fact on chant/lifecycle
the alert agent's workflow runs and opens its pull request

break.note: main sets agent.comment and leaves agent.alert off, so plywood ci writes no alert workflow, the dispatch is refused and the agent-pull step must fail. This runs on Forgejo only: the bench has no GitHub or GitLab, and those forges' dispatch paths are not exercised.
